observations.summary: Red caller/tool cancellation and pending receipt teardown reproduced; shared source and service drain now pass source and exchange regressions. Evidence: repair-lifetime-red.log, repair-service-red.log, repair-app-final.log.

Shared invocation records one start and terminal event; cancelled-before-owner reports not-started. Actual Responses calls preserve exact provider payload and terminal progress, including legitimate failed/partial settlement. Native cases preserved. Evidence: repair-terminal-red.log, repair-observation-prompt-final.log, repair-canonical-final.log.

Removed custom HTTP batch source/configuration/catalog and former tests of that protocol. Browser session-unavailable remains actionable. Explicit removed identities reject without network fallback. Evidence: repair-routing-red.log, repair-app-final.log, repair-browser-final.log.

Non-Design publication uses its actual owner registry; browser/Feature/runtime exchange proves canonical mutation, repair, permissions, partial completion, next-turn reuse and selected media. Actual installed native registration passes without inference. Evidence: repair-contract-red.log, repair-runtime-final.log, repair-canonical-final.log, repair-native-registration.log.

Four current owner handoffs reviewed and focused acceptance complete. No compatibility, weakened admission or alternate executor. Type, lint and naming gates scoped to this work. No live model acceptance or 101 claim.
